method: 逐段核对英文原文、对应中文及已解码音轨的下一词开口。分句间有停顿时在停顿中点切换；连续语流在下一词附近的低能量点切换。

cuts.en: forward-facing eyes, a large grey beak, large blue feet, and relatively short wings and tail.
cuts.zh: 它双眼朝前，喙大而灰，两脚硕大、呈蓝色，翅膀和尾巴相对较短。

cuts.en: to three island sanctuaries: Codfish Island, Maud Island and Little Barrier Island.
cuts.zh: 目的地是三处海岛保护区，即科德菲什岛、莫德岛和小巴里尔岛。

cuts.en: together with a specialist advisory group called the Kākāpō Scientific and Technical Advisory Committee and a higher amount of funding.
cuts.zh: 同时成立了名为“鸮鹦鹉科学技术咨询委员会”的专家咨询小组，并增加了经费。

cuts.en: restore or maintain sufficient habitat to accommodate the expected increase in the kākāpō population,
cuts.zh: 恢复或维持足够的栖息地，为鸮鹦鹉种群的预期增长留出空间；

cuts.en: and ensure stakeholders continue to be fully engaged in the preservation of the species.
cuts.zh: 确保各利益相关方继续充分参与这一物种的保护。
